{{Top|leg}}
'''Sniffers''' were [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] that absorbed molecules in the air and then analyzed them for the presence of hazardous chemicals. Sniffers were deployed in the field in a standby mode, passively gathering data and warning the operator to the presence of dangerous chemicals through an auditory or vibratory alarm. [[Neuro-Saav Technologies/Legends|Neuro-Saav]] manufactured the [[ChemDetect]] sniffer.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
